# wordpress_wp_api_settings (Resource)

Manages WordPress site settings through the REST API (https://developer.wordpress.org/rest-api/reference/settings/). WordPress does not support deleting site settings; destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date_format` (String) Site date format.
- `default_category` (Number) Default post category.
- `default_comment_status` (String) Default comment status.
- `default_ping_status` (String) Default ping status.
- `default_post_format` (String) Default post format.
- `description` (String) Site tagline.
- `email` (String) Administration email address.
- `language` (String) WordPress locale code.
- `page_for_posts` (Number) Posts page ID.
- `page_on_front` (Number) Front page ID.
- `posts_per_page` (Number) Maximum posts shown on a blog page.
- `show_on_front` (String) Front page display mode.
- `site_icon` (Number) Site icon media ID.
- `site_logo` (Number) Site logo media ID.
- `start_of_week` (Number) First day of the week.
- `time_format` (String) Site time format.
- `timezone` (String) Site timezone.
- `title` (String) Site title.
- `url` (String) Site URL.
- `use_smilies` (Boolean) Whether to convert emoticons to graphics.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
